title: Senior Full Stack Java Engineer
description: Nexus Innovations is looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Java Engineer to lead the architecture and development of our next-generation cloud-native financial intelligence platform. You will design resilient microservices, build sleek user interfaces, and collaborate closely with cross-functional product teams.
responsibilities: Architect and implement scalable RESTful and event-driven microservices using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Build dynamic, high-performance web interfaces with modern JavaScript and design systems.
Optimize database queries, indices, and caching strategies across PostgreSQL and Redis.
Collaborate with DevOps engineers to establish robust CI/CD pipelines on AWS / Docker.
Mentor junior and mid-level developers through thorough code reviews and design sessions.
requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
4+ years of professional software engineering experience with Java ecosystem.
Deep understanding of multithreading, concurrent programming, and JVM internals.
Proficiency with modern web frontend technologies (HTML5, modern CSS, ES6+ JavaScript).
Hands-on experience with SQL databases, Docker, and REST architectural standards.
benefits: Flexible hybrid working model with modern home office allowance.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and health coverage for you and dependents.
Annual learning stipend of ₹1,00,000 for certifications and conferences.
Generous equity and annual performance performance bonus.

responsibilities: Develop modular, themeable UI component libraries conforming to WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
Optimize browser rendering performance, bundle sizes, and Core Web Vitals.

Implement comprehensive end-to-end and component testing suites.
requirements: Proven track record building modern, high-polish web applications.
Mastery of modern CSS (CSS Grid, Flexbox, CSS Variables, fluid animations).
Deep understanding of state management, browser internals, and TypeScript / JavaScript.
Strong portfolio demonstrating aesthetic excellence and attention to detail.
benefits: 100% remote flexibility worldwide.
Latest M3 Max MacBook Pro + 4K dual monitor home office setup.
Unlimited paid time off (minimum 25 days encouraged).
Annual global company retreat in Europe or Asia.

title: Backend Distributed Systems Engineer

responsibilities: Build high-throughput streaming pipelines processing 500k+ messages/sec.
Design fault-tolerant storage engines and distributed caches.
Benchmark, profile, and eliminate latency bottlenecks in production.
Participate in on-call rotations and write comprehensive post-mortems.
requirements: Strong command of Java, Go, or C++ with knowledge of memory management.
Experience with Apache Kafka, Raft/Paxos consensus, or distributed datastores.
Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and networking protocols (TCP, gRPC, HTTP/3).
benefits: Top-tier competitive base salary + lucrative equity grants.
Daily gourmet catered meals and barista in our SF downtown office.
Full 401(k) matching up to 6% and premium health coverage.

Working knowledge of Vector Search (Milvus, Pinecone, Qdrant) and LLM orchestration frameworks.
Understanding of model inference optimization, tokenization, and embeddings.

Wellness stipend and monthly health club membership.
